name: email-get
description: Fetch the full content (including body) of a single email message by its Nylas message ID. Use email-list to find message IDs first. Returns non-inline attachments with IDs that can be used with email-download-attachment.

inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID of the email to fetch)
inputs.account: string? (named account to read from, as configured in channel_accounts.email. Defaults to the primary account.)

outputs.message: object ({ id, threadId, subject, from, to, cc, body, date, unread, folders, attachments: [{ id, filename, contentType, size }] })
